Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in the initial analysis by incorrectly identifying the director of the film *Safe* (2012) as Boaz Yakin. Boaz Yakin directed *Safe* (2000), not the 2012 version. The 2012 film *Safe* was directed by Eran Creevy. Consequently, the entire comparison was based on the wrong director (Boaz Yakin, born 1965) instead of the correct one (Eran Creevy, born 1975). Even though Pupi Avati (born 1938) was correctly identified, the error in identifying the second director led to an incorrect conclusion that Boaz Yakin was born first. The Planner's instruction to look up Boaz Yakin for the 2012 film was the root cause of the failure.
